40020471.author: पदार्थः
40020471.content: स he, जित्वा having conquered, धनदं the bestower of wealth (Kubera), राम O Rama, भ्रातरं his brother, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas, महासेनप्रसूतिं the birthplace of Mahasena (Kartikeya), तत् that, ययौ went, शरवणं the thicket of reeds, महत् great.

40020471.author: Translation
40020471.content: O Rama, having conquered his brother Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas then went to that great thicket of reeds, the birthplace of Kartikeya.

40020472.author: पदार्थः
40020472.content: अथ then, अपश्यत् saw, दशग्रीवः Daśagrīva (Ravana), रौक्मं golden, शरवणं the thicket of reeds, महत् great, गभस्तिजालसंवीतं enveloped in a network of rays, द्वितीयम् a second, इव like, भास्करम् sun.

40020472.author: Translation
40020472.content: Then Daśagrīva (Ravana) saw that great golden thicket of reeds, which was enveloped in a network of rays, appearing like a second sun.

40020473.author: पदार्थः
40020473.content: स he, पर्वतं a mountain, समारुह्य having ascended, कञ्चित् some, रम्यवनान्तरम् having beautiful forest interiors, अपश्यत् saw, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka (aerial chariot), तत्र there, रामविष्टम्भितं stopped by Rama, तदा then.

40020473.author: Translation
40020473.content: Then, having ascended a certain mountain with beautiful forest interiors, he saw the Pushpaka aerial chariot stopped there by Rama.

40020474.author: पदार्थः
40020474.content: विष्टब्धं stopped, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka, दृष्ट्वा having seen, हि indeed, अगमं motionless, कामागं moving at will, कृतम् become, अचिन्तयत् thought, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, सचिवैः by ministers, तैः those, समावृतः surrounded.

40020474.author: Translation
40020474.content: Seeing the Pushpaka chariot, which was supposed to move at will, now stopped and motionless, the lord of Rakshasas, surrounded by his ministers, began to ponder.

40020475.author: पदार्थः
40020475.content: किन्निमित्तं for what reason, च and, इच्छया by will, मे my, न not, इदं this, गच्छति moves, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, उपरिष्ठस्य situated above, कर्म deed, इदं this, कस्यचित् of someone, भवेत् might be.

40020475.author: Translation
40020475.content: He wondered why this Pushpaka, which should move according to his will, was not moving, and speculated that this obstruction might be the work of someone on top of the mountain.

40020476.author: पदार्थः
40020476.content: ततः then, अब्रवीत् spoke, तदा at that time, राम O Rama, मारीचः Maricha, बुद्धिकोविदः wise, न not, इदं this, निष्कारणं without reason, राजन् O King, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka, यत् which, न not, गच्छति moves.

40020476.author: Translation
40020476.content: Then, at that moment, the wise Maricha spoke, saying, "O King, this Pushpaka chariot does not stop moving without a cause."

40020477.author: पदार्थः
40020477.content: अथवा or, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka, इदं this, धनदात् from Kubera, न not, अन्यवाहनम् another's vehicle, अतः therefore, निष्पन्दम् motionless, अभवत् became, धनाध्यक्षविनाकृतम् deprived of the lord of wealth.

40020477.author: Translation
40020477.content: Alternatively, he suggested that this Pushpaka, being Kubera's vehicle and not meant for anyone else, has become motionless because it is now separated from its true owner, the lord of wealth.

40020478.author: पदार्थः
40020478.content: इति thus, वाक्यान्तरे in the middle of the speech, तस्य his, करालः formidable, कृष्णपिङ्गलः black and tawny, वामनः dwarf, विकटः monstrous, मुण्डी bald-headed, नन्दी Nandi, प्रह्वभुजः with bowed arms, बली powerful.

40020478.author: Translation
40020478.content: Just as Maricha was speaking, a formidable, black and tawny, dwarfish, monstrous, bald-headed, powerful being named Nandi, with bowed arms, appeared.

40020479.author: पदार्थः
40020479.content: ततः then, पार्श्वम् side, उपागम्य having approached, भवस्य of Bhava (Shiva), अनुचरः attendant, अब्रवीत् spoke, नन्दीश्वरः Nandi, the lord, वचः words, च and, इदम् these, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the lord of Rakshasas, अशङ्कितः fearless,

40020479.author: Translation
40020479.content: Then, Nandi, the fearless attendant of Shiva, approached the lord of Rakshasas and spoke these words.

40020480.author: पदार्थः
40020480.content: निवर्तस्व turn back, दशग्रीव O Dashagriva, शैले on the mountain, क्रीडति plays, शङ्करः Shankara, सुपर्णनागयक्षाणाम् of Suparnas, Nagas, and Yakshas, देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् of Devas, Gandharvas, and Rakshasas,

40020480.author: Translation
40020480.content: "Turn back, O Dashagriva, for Shankara is sporting on this mountain, which is inaccessible to Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Devas, Gandharvas, and Rakshasas."

40020481.author: पदार्थः
40020481.content: सर्वेषाम् of all, एव indeed, भूतानाम् beings, अगम्यः inaccessible, पर्वतः mountain, कृतः made, इति thus, नन्दिवचः Nandi's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, क्रोधात् from anger, कम्पितकुण्डलः with trembling earrings,

40020481.author: Translation
40020481.content: "This mountain has been made inaccessible to all beings," Nandi declared, and having heard these words, Ravana's earrings trembled with anger.

40020482.author: पदार्थः
40020482.content: रोषात् from rage, तु indeed, ताम्रनयनः with coppery eyes, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka (chariot), अवरुह्य having descended, सः he, कः who, अयम् this, शङ्करः Shankara, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, शैलमूलम् to the base of the mountain, उपागतः approached,

40020482.author: Translation
40020482.content: With eyes reddened by rage, he descended from the Pushpaka chariot, exclaiming, "Who is this Shankara?" and approached the base of the mountain.

40020483.author: पदार्थः
40020483.content: सः he, अपश्यत् saw, नन्दिनम् Nandi, तत्र there, देवस्य of the god (Shiva), अदूरतः not far, स्थितम् standing, दीप्तम् shining, शूलम् trident, अवष्टभ्य holding firmly, द्वितीयम् second, इव like, शङ्करम् Shankara,

40020483.author: Translation
40020483.content: There, not far from Shiva, he saw Nandi standing, firmly holding a shining trident, appearing like a second Shankara himself.

40020484.author: पदार्थः
40020484.content: तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वानरमुखम् monkey-faced, अवज्ञाय having disdained, सः that, राक्षसः demon, प्रहासं a loud laugh, मुमुचे released, तत्र there, सतोयः with water, इव like, तोयदः a cloud.

40020484.author: Translation
40020484.content: That demon, having seen his monkey-face and disdained him, burst into a loud laugh there, like a cloud thundering with water.

40020485.author: पदार्थः
40020485.content: तं to him, क्रुद्धः enraged, भगवान् the divine, नन्दी Nandi, शङ्करस्य of Shiva, अपरा another, तनुः form, अब्रवीत् spoke, तत्र there, तद्रक्षः to that demon, दशाननम् to the ten-headed one, उपस्थितम् who was present.

40020485.author: Translation
40020485.content: Enraged, the divine Nandi, who was another form of Shiva, spoke there to that demon Ravana who was present.

40020486.author: पदार्थः
40020486.content: यस्मात् because, वानररूपं monkey-formed, माम् me, अवज्ञाय having disdained, दशानन O ten-headed one, अशनीपातसङ्काशम् resembling a thunderbolt's fall, अपहासं a loud laugh, प्रमुक्तवान् you have uttered.

40020486.author: Translation
40020486.content: Because, O ten-headed one, you have disdained me, who am in the form of a monkey, and uttered a loud laugh resembling the fall of a thunderbolt.

40020487.author: पदार्थः
40020487.content: तस्मात् therefore, मद्रूपसम्पन्नाः endowed with my form, मद्वीर्यसमतेजसः having might and splendor equal to mine, उत्पत्स्यन्ति will be born, वधार्थं for the purpose of destruction, हि indeed, कुलस्य of the lineage, तव your, वानराः monkeys.

40020487.author: Translation
40020487.content: Therefore, monkeys endowed with my form and possessing might and splendor equal to mine will indeed be born for the destruction of your lineage.

40020488.author: पदार्थः
40020488.content: नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः having nails and fangs as weapons, क्रूराः fierce, मनःसम्पातरंहसः having speed like the flight of thought, युद्धोन्मत्ताः intoxicated with battle, बलोद्रिक्ताः overflowing with strength, शैलाः mountains, इव like, विसर्पिणः moving.

40020488.author: Translation
40020488.content: They will be fierce, with nails and fangs as their weapons, swift as thought, intoxicated with battle, overflowing with strength, and moving like mountains.

40020489.author: पदार्थः
40020489.content: ते they, तव your, प्रबलं mighty, दर्पम् arrogance, उत्सेधं haughtiness, च and, पृथग्विधम् of various kinds, व्यपनेष्यन्ति will remove, सम्भूय having come together, सहामात्यसुतस्य along with your ministers and sons, च and.

40020489.author: Translation
40020489.content: They will unitedly destroy your mighty and diverse arrogance and haughtiness, along with your ministers and sons.

40020490.author: पदार्थः
40020490.content: किं what, तु but, इदानीं now, मया by me, शक्यं possible, हन्तुं to kill, त्वां you, हे O, निशाचर night-wanderer, न not, हन्तव्यो to be killed, हतः killed, त्वं you, हि indeed, पूर्वमेव already, स्वकर्मभिः by your own deeds.

40020490.author: Translation
40020490.content: O night-wanderer, what is possible for me to do to kill you now, for you are not to be killed, as you have already been destroyed by your own actions.

40020491.author: पदार्थः
40020491.content: इति thus, उदीरितवाक्ये when the words were spoken, तु indeed, देवे by the god, तस्मिन् by that, महात्मनि great-souled one, देवदुन्दुभयः divine drums, नेदुः sounded, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, च and, खात् from the sky, च्युता fell.

40020491.author: Translation
40020491.content: When those words were spoken by that great-souled god, divine drums sounded, and a shower of flowers fell from the sky.

40020492.author: पदार्थः
40020492.content: अचिन्तयित्वा not considering, सः he, तदा then, नन्दिवाक्यं Nandi's words, महाबलः the mighty one, पर्वतं the mountain, तु but, समासाद्य having approached, वाक्यम् words, आह spoke, दशाननः Dashanana.

40020492.author: Translation
40020492.content: Disregarding Nandi's words, the mighty Dashanana then approached the mountain and spoke.

40020493.author: पदार्थः
40020493.content: पुष्पकस्य of the Pushpaka, गतिः movement, छिन्ना obstructed, यत्कृते because of which, मम my, गच्छतः going, तम् that, इमं this, शैलम् mountain, उन्मूलं uprooted, करोमि I will make, तव your, गोपते O lord of cattle.

40020493.author: Translation
40020493.content: O lord of cattle, I will uproot this mountain, because of which the movement of my Pushpaka chariot has been obstructed while I was going.

40020494.author: पदार्थः
40020494.content: केन by what, प्रभावेण power, भवो Shiva, नित्यं constantly, क्रीडति plays, राजवत् like a king, विज्ञातव्यं what should be known, न not, जानीते knows, भयस्थानम् place of fear, उपस्थितम् present.

40020494.author: Translation
40020494.content: By what power does Shiva constantly play like a king, not recognizing the imminent danger that should be known?

40020495.author: पदार्थः
40020495.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, ततो then, राम O Rama, भुजान् arms, विक्षिप्य having spread out, पर्वते on the mountain, तोलयामास he began to lift, तं that, शीघ्रं quickly, स that, शैलं mountain, समकम्पत trembled.

40020495.author: Translation
40020495.content: Having thus spoken, O Rama, (Ravana) spread his arms on the mountain and quickly began to lift it, causing that mountain to tremble.

40020496.author: पदार्थः
40020496.content: चालनात् from the shaking, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, एव indeed, गणाः the attendants, देवस्य of the god (Shiva), कम्पिताः trembled, चचाल trembled, पार्वती Parvati, च and, अपि also, तदा then, आश्लिष्टा having embraced, महेश्वरम् Maheshvara.

40020496.author: Translation
40020496.content: Due to the shaking of the mountain, Shiva's attendants trembled, and Parvati, who was embracing Maheshvara, also trembled then.

40020497.author: पदार्थः
40020497.content: ततो then, राम O Rama, महादेवो the great god, देवानां of the gods, प्रवरो the foremost, हरः Hara (Shiva), पादाङ्गुष्ठेन with the big toe, तं that, शैलं mountain, पीडयामास pressed down, लीलया playfully.

40020497.author: Translation
40020497.content: Then, O Rama, the great god Hara, the foremost among the gods, playfully pressed down that mountain with his big toe.

40020498.author: पदार्थः
40020498.content: पीडिताः crushed, तु indeed, ततस् then, तस्य his, शैलस्य of the mountain, अधोगताः went down, भुजाः arms, विस्मिताः astonished, च and, अभवन् became, तत्र there, सचिवाः the ministers, तस्य his, रक्षसः of the demon.

40020498.author: Translation
40020498.content: Indeed, his arms were then crushed beneath the mountain, and the demon's ministers there became astonished.

40020499.author: पदार्थः
40020499.content: रक्षसा by the demon, तेन by him, रोषात् from anger, च and, भुजानाम् of the arms, पीडनात् from the pressing, तदा then, मुक्तः released, विरावः a cry, सहसा suddenly, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, येन by which, कम्पितम् was shaken.

40020499.author: Translation
40020499.content: Then, from the anger and the crushing of his arms, that demon suddenly let out a roar by which the three worlds were shaken.

40020500.author: पदार्थः
40020500.content: मेनिरे they considered, वज्रनिष्पेषम् a thunderbolt's strike, तस्य his, अमात्याः ministers, युगक्षये at the end of an age; तदा then, वर्त्मस्थचलिताः disturbed from their paths, देवाः the gods, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः with Indra as their leader.

40020500.author: Translation
40020500.content: His ministers considered the sound to be a thunderbolt's strike signaling the end of an age, while the gods, led by Indra, were disturbed from their celestial paths.

40020501.author: पदार्थः
40020501.content: समुद्राः the oceans, च and, अपि also, सङ्क्षुब्धाः greatly agitated, चलिताः moved, च and, अपि also, पर्वताः the mountains; यक्षाः Yakshas, विद्याधराः Vidyadharas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, किम् what, एतत् is this, इति thus, च and, अब्रुवन् they said.

40020501.author: Translation
40020501.content: The oceans became greatly agitated, the mountains were shaken, and Yakshas, Vidyadharas, and Siddhas all exclaimed, "What is this?"

40020502.author: पदार्थः
40020502.content: अथ then, ते those, मन्त्रिणः ministers, तस्य his, विक्रोशन्तम् to the one who was crying out, अथ then, अब्रुवन् they said, तोषयस्व please propitiate, महादेवम् Mahadeva, नीलकण्ठम् the blue-throated one, उमापतिम् the husband of Uma.

40020502.author: Translation
40020502.content: Then his ministers said to him, who was crying out, "Please propitiate Mahadeva, the blue-throated one, the husband of Uma."

40020503.author: पदार्थः
40020503.content: तम् him, ऋते without, शरणम् refuge, न not, अन्यम् another, पश्यामः we see, अत्र here, दशानन O ten-headed one; स्तुतिभिः with praises, प्रणतः bowed down, भूत्वा having become, तम् him, एव only, शरणम् refuge, व्रज seek.

40020503.author: Translation
40020503.content: "O ten-headed one, we see no other refuge here except him; therefore, having bowed down with praises, seek refuge in him alone."

40020504.author: पदार्थः
40020504.content: कृपालुः compassionate, शङ्करः Shankara, तुष्टः pleased, प्रसादम् grace, ते to you, विधास्यति will bestow, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तदा then, अमात्यैः by the ministers, तुष्टाव praised, वृषभध्वजम् the one with the bull banner.

40020504.author: Translation
40020504.content: The compassionate Lord Shankara, being pleased, will bestow his grace upon you; thus advised by his ministers, Ravana then praised Lord Shiva.

40020505.author: पदार्थः
40020505.content: सामभिः with hymns, विविधैः various, स्तोत्रैः with praises, प्रणम्य having bowed down, सः he, दशाननः the ten-headed one, संवत्सरसहस्रम् a thousand years, तु indeed, रुदतः of the crying one, रक्षसः of the demon, गतम् passed.

40020505.author: Translation
40020505.content: Having bowed down with various hymns and praises, the ten-headed Ravana spent a thousand years crying and performing penance.

40020506.author: पदार्थः
40020506.content: ततः then, प्रीतः pleased, महादेवः the great god, शैलाग्रे on the peak of the mountain, विष्ठितः situated, प्रभुः the lord, मुक्त्वा having released, च and, अस्य his, भुजान् arms, राम O Rama, प्राह spoke, वाक्यम् words, दशाननम् to the ten-headed one.

40020506.author: Translation
40020506.content: Then, O Rama, the pleased Lord Mahadeva, situated on the mountain peak, released Ravana's arms and spoke to the ten-headed one.

40020507.author: पदार्थः
40020507.content: प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, तव your, वीर्यस्य of valor, शौण्डार्यात् of prowess, च and, दशानन O ten-headed one, शैलाक्रान्तेन by the mountain being pressed, यः which, मुक्तः released, त्वया by you, रावः cry, सुदारुणः very terrible.

40020507.author: Translation
40020507.content: O ten-headed one, I am pleased with your valor and prowess, demonstrated by the very terrible cry you released while being crushed by the mountain.

40020508.author: पदार्थः
40020508.content: यस्मात् because, लोकत्रयम् the three worlds, च and, एतत् this, रावितम् made to cry out, भयम् fear, आगतम् came, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, रावणः Ravana, नाम named, नाम्ना by name, राजन् O king, भविष्यसि will be.

40020508.author: Translation
40020508.content: Because the three worlds were made to cry out and fear came upon them due to your roar, therefore, O king, you shall henceforth be known by the name Ravana.

40020509.author: पदार्थः
40020509.content: देवता gods, मानुषा humans, यक्षा yakshas, ये who, च and, अन्ये others, जगतीतले on the earth's surface, एवम् thus, त्वाम् you, अभिधास्यन्ति will call, रावणम् Ravana, लोकरावणम् one who makes the worlds cry.

40020509.author: Translation
40020509.content: Gods, humans, yakshas, and all others on earth will thus call you Ravana, the one who makes the worlds cry.

40020510.author: पदार्थः
40020510.content: गच्छ go, पौलस्त्य O son of Pulastya, विस्रब्धम् confidently, पथा by the path, येन by which, त्वम् you, इच्छसि desire, मया by me, च and, एव indeed, अभ्यनुज्ञातः permitted, राक्षसाधिप O king of rakshasas, गम्यताम् you may go.

40020510.author: Translation
40020510.content: O son of Pulastya, O king of rakshasas, go confidently by the path you desire, for you are indeed permitted by me to depart.

40020511.author: पदार्थः
40020511.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, शम्भुना by Shambhu, स्वयम् himself, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रीतः pleased, यदि if, महादेव O Mahadeva, वरम् a boon, मे to me, देहि give, याचतः who is asking.

40020511.author: Translation
40020511.content: Thus spoken to by Shambhu, the lord of Lanka himself replied, "If you are pleased, O Mahadeva, then grant me a boon as I ask."

40020512.author: पदार्थः
40020512.content: अवध्यत्वम् invincibility, मया by me, प्राप्तम् obtained, देवगन्धर्वदानवैः from gods, gandharvas, and danavas, राक्षसैः from rakshasas, गुह्यकैः from guhyakas, नागैः from nagas, ये who, च and, अन्ये others, बलवत्तराः more powerful.

40020512.author: Translation
40020512.content: I have already obtained the boon of invincibility against gods, gandharvas, danavas, rakshasas, guhyakas, nagas, and any other more powerful beings.

40020513.author: पदार्थः
40020513.content: मानुषान् humans, न not, गणे I count, देव O god, स्वल्पाः insignificant, ते they, मम to me, सम्मताः considered, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, च and, मे by me, प्राप्तम् obtained, ब्रह्मणः from Brahma, त्रिपुरान्तक O destroyer of Tripura.

40020513.author: Translation
40020513.content: O god, I do not count humans, as they are considered insignificant by me; and O destroyer of Tripura, I have already obtained a long life from Brahma.

40020514.author: पदार्थः
40020514.content: वाञ्छितं desired, च and, आयुषः of life, शेषं remaining part, शस्त्रं weapon, त्वं you, च and, प्रयच्छ give, मे to me, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, ततः then, तेन by him, रावणेन by Ravana, सः that, शङ्करः Shankara.

40020514.author: Translation
40020514.content: Ravana thus requested Lord Shankara to grant him his desired remaining lifespan and a weapon.

40020515.author: पदार्थः
40020515.content: ददौ gave, खड्गं sword, महादीप्तं greatly radiant, चन्द्रहासम् Chandrahāsa, इति thus, श्रुतम् known, आयुषः of life, च and, अवशेषं remainder, च and, स्थित्वा having granted, भूतपतिः Lord of beings, तदा then.

40020515.author: Translation
40020515.content: Then, Lord Shiva, the lord of beings, granted him the greatly radiant sword known as Chandrahāsa, and also the remainder of his life.

40020516.author: पदार्थः
40020516.content: दत्त्वा having given, उवाच said, ततः then, शम्भुः Shambhu, न not, अवज्ञेयम् to be disregarded, इदं this, त्वया by you, अवज्ञातं disregarded, यदि if, हि indeed, ते by you, माम् to me, एव indeed, एष्यति will come, असंशयः without doubt.

40020516.author: Translation
40020516.content: Having given it, Shambhu then said, "This (sword) is not to be disrespected by you; if it is indeed disregarded by you, it will undoubtedly return to me."

40020517.author: पदार्थः
40020517.content: एवम् thus, महेश्वरेण by Maheśvara, एव indeed, कृतनामा one whose name was made, सः that, रावणः Ravana, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महादेवम् Mahadeva, आरुरोह ascended, अथ then, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka.

40020517.author: Translation
40020517.content: Thus, Ravana, whose name was indeed established by Maheśvara, then saluted Mahadeva and ascended the Pushpaka chariot.

40020518.author: पदार्थः
40020518.content: ततः then, महीतले on the earth's surface, राम O Rama, पर्यक्रामत roamed about, रावणः Ravana, क्षत्ऺित्रयान् Kshatriyas, सुमहावीर्यान् very mighty, बाधमानः harassing, इतस्ततः here and there.

40020518.author: Translation
40020518.content: Then, O Rama, Ravana roamed about on the earth's surface, harassing very mighty Kshatriyas here and there.

40020519.author: पदार्थः
40020519.content: केचित् some, तेजस्विनः powerful, शूराः brave, क्षत्ऺित्रया Kshatriyas, युद्धदुर्मदाः unyielding in battle, तच्छासनम् his command, अकुर्वन्तः not obeying, विनेशुः perished, सपरिच्छदाः along with their retinue.

40020519.author: Translation
40020519.content: Some powerful and brave Kshatriyas, unyielding in battle, who disobeyed his command, perished along with their retinue.

40020520.author: पदार्थः
40020520.content: अपरे others, दुर्जयम् unconquerable, रक्षो Rakshasa, जानन्तः knowing, प्राज्ञसम्मताः approved by the wise, जिताः स्म we are conquered, इति thus, अभाषन्त they spoke, राक्षसम् to the Rakshasa, बलदर्पितम् proud of his strength.

40020520.author: Translation
40020520.content: Others, knowing the Rakshasa to be unconquerable and being considered wise, declared to the strength-proud Rakshasa, "We are conquered.". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षोडशः सर्गः ।। 16 ।। Thus ends the sixteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
